summary: Frontend regression for Eurogulf: verified Arabic nav+footer translations & RTL, hover dropdowns, language toggle mapping, Arabic Cairo font, light-mode hero contrast across 9 tagged pages, image loading on 5 key pages, Arabic homepage CTAs and inner /ar routes, InstagramPosts hidden while embed present, mobile /ar menu, theme toggle persistence, and one backend smoke curl.

minor.issue: Returns 404 (health endpoint defined as GET /health at root only, not under /api). Not a regression, informational.

ui_bugs.issue: React warning 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' still fires on /ar. Iteration 18 flagged the same. Likely duplicate key in brands.map (uses key={b.title}) — verify brand titles are unique in i18n/ar.js, or stats labels not colliding. Non-breaking but should be fixed.

action_items: Resolve HomePageAr duplicate React key warning (check brands.map key uniqueness in /app/frontend/src/pages/ar/HomePageAr.js and /app/frontend/src/i18n/ar.js brand titles; switch key to link or index).
critical_code_review_comments: HomePageAr.js: key={b.title} risks collision. Prefer key={b.link} or key={`${b.title}-${i}`}.

success_rate.frontend: ~98% (all specified checks pass except pre-existing key warning)

seed_data_creation: One TEST_ contact via POST /api/contact for smoke.

images_broken.note: No had complete=true && naturalWidth=0. Some below-fold lazy images had complete=false at snapshot time, expected.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Arabic nav/footer translation, light-mode hero contrast, language toggle mapping, Cairo font, image loads, /ar inner pages all verified passing. Only outstanding issue is a benign React duplicate-key warning on HomePageAr (already present in iter 18). Backend contact endpoint is POST /api/contact (singular), not /api/contacts. Health endpoint is only /health (no /api prefix).
rca_of_the_issue: HomePageAr key warning: brands.map uses key={b.title}; if any two brand titles in i18n/ar.js resolve to the same Arabic string (or if stats labels collide), React logs the warning. Mitigation: switch to key={b.link} which is unique per route.
